annotations.text:
DESKTOP · 1440×900
The dashboard leads with one job: get back into the CV you were writing. The four vanity stat cards drop to a quiet 'At a glance' list in the rail.

MOBILE · 390×844
Same two screens on a phone. Frosted bottom bar, 44px+ hit targets everywhere, and the builder splits into Write / Preview so neither is cramped.

WHAT CHANGED IN THE INTERFACE

1. One obvious next action. The dashboard's 'Continue where you left off' card names the specific next step, not just a percentage.

2. The builder is three zones instead of two: section rail (with progress), one section at a time in the editor, live A4 preview.

3. Guidance sits under the field before you get it wrong — no red until you're done typing.

4. 'Fix' shortcuts jump straight to the thing that needs work.

5. A route to a human on every screen.

The CV sheet itself stays white and print-safe — untouched by the app theme, as in the current code.
